eval: const r = await (await fetch('/__server?hang=1', { cache: 'no-store' })).json(); return { hang: r.hang }

name: Without signal another file from the app's site comes from the cache after the time limit
Signal back: held requests are answered
eval: const r = await (await fetch('/__server?hang=0', { cache: 'no-store' })).json(); return { hang: r.hang, held: r.held }

name: A new version (new sw.js) is installed in the background and the update bar appears
Reload loads the new version without showing the bar again
After Reload: page controlled by the new worker, bar hidden
eval:
const reg = await navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistration();
return { controlled: !!navigator.serviceWorker.controller, bar: !document.getElementById('update-bar').hidden, reloaded: !window.__old, newSw: reg.active.scriptURL.endsWith('/sw.js') && (await caches.keys()).includes('addturngpx-test-next') }
